title: “Meh”.... ok
text: It was ok. I ordered this for my twin granddaughters for Christmas. I thought a monthly gift would be a nice surprise! Especially during the pandemic! The girls were excited to get their first box. But they were not as excited after opening the box. I should have read the description better. But I did do 3 months before I cancelled to be sure if the girls would have enjoyed it. They were “meh” about the box. Some of the recipes were hard to find ingredients too. I thought there would be more things in the box besides recipe, a spoon, and stickers. For the $20 plus a month, my daughter in law could go to Pinterest to find kid friendly recipes ideas for free. So, I will look around for a more exciting “boxes” of the month for my twin granddaughters!
label: neutral
